test_title: PYST 1: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct sentence:
P: the minister
Q: gave a briefing
R: on key reforms
S: to the media
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (2)** i.e. **PQSR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence begins with "the minister" which is correctly indicated by **part (P).**
 
• Following the subject, "gave a briefing" **(PQ)** logically continues, making it clear what the minister did.
 
• **The next part,** "to the media," starts the explanation about the audience, indicated
